item_name: Rothco Don't Tread On Me Flag
item_short_desc: Rothco's "Don't Tread On Me" Flag proudly displays the iconic Gadsden symbol, making a strong statement with its historical significance. The flag features the well-known snake and "Don't Tread On Me" image printed on a bright yellow background, ensuring visibility and impact. Made from durable polyester, this flag is designed to withstand outdoor elements while retaining its vibrant colors. Available in 2 sizes, 2 feet x 3 feet, 3 feet x 5 feet, and 5 feet x 8 feet it offers options for various display needs.
